'''Pandath''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]]. A spaceport, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] departed from this [[City/Legends|city]] to engage [[Norulac Freebooters|Norulac pirates]] in the [[Battle of Taanab/Legends|Battle of Taanab]]. A [[Jedi chapter house (Taanab)/Legends|Jedi chapter house]] was established in the city to house initiates in the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]].

On [[0 ABY/Legends|35:8:16]], the [[Imperial HoloVision]] node based in the city reported the crash of the supply ship ''[[Ambitious]]'' at the [[B'Knos]] mining colony.<ref name="TTaBS">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>
